supporting_pages.title: "AI agent listing requirements and metadata \_|\_ Google Cloud Marketplace\
evidence_snippets: Common business functions include: Customer Support Sales Marketing Human Resources Finance Operations Category Ensure that your AI agent is assigned to the correct primary and secondary categories.

The category selection process in Producer Portal helps classify your product within the broader Cloud Marketplace taxonomy, which is used by both the standard search filters and the AI discovery engine.
This helps customers searching for solutions to specific departmental problems (for example, "customer support automation" or "sales forecasting").

evidence_snippets: Category IDs let customers find your product under select categories or filters as they search Cloud Marketplace.
While completing Product info , you can add Category IDs.
You can add up to two Category IDs for a product.
